item.text: I found the concrete causes: the server never invokes the shared parser, SQL `LIKE` treats `%` and `_` as wildcards, comment documents lack project IDs, and reindex requests only handle issues. I’m also checking archive-aware reads and all update events, since the ADR requires stale or archived items to stay out of the index.
